frames.name: Принц
frames.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent circular avatar overlay frame for Heroes of Ether fantasy game. Style references only: image 1 rounded ring profile and volume, image 2 soft gold and enamel. Primary request: a NEW frame, never a medal or filled badge. Soft casual fantasy 2.5D, rounded sculpted forms, broad smooth shading, saturated colours, satin materials, restrained small highlights from upper left. NO rough scratches, intricate filigree, white glare, rays, sparks, letters, numbers, ribbons with writing, face or character. Geometry: square image, front view perfectly circular ring, centre of circular opening exactly at canvas (50%,52%), clear circular opening diameter 63% of canvas; outer ring diameter about 78%; small attached decoration can extend to 94% canvas but never clipped. The entire circular centre hole and outside silhouette must be true transparent alpha, absolutely no solid disk, backdrop, shadow inside hole or checkerboard. Ring continuous all 360 degrees. Balanced and readable at 64px. Elegant youthful prince: warm gold ring with royal blue enamel inset, small gold three-point coronet at top bearing one blue sapphire; two compact rounded leaf accents at lower sides. Modest compared to king.
